Project workspace is ready. Continue with the user's original request.

Taste profile: Enterprise Admin
  • DO: Use dense, data-forward layout with tight spacing rhythm throughout dispatch and billing views
  • DO: Apply semantic colors strictly for status indicators (confirmed, error, pending) — not decoration
  • DO: Use strong typographic hierarchy with borders over shadows for separation
  • DONT: No flashy gradients or oversized decorative cards
  • DONT: No unnecessary shadows or visual noise — let structure do the work
  • DONT: No generic template layouts — every screen must feel purpose-built for logistics ops
Density: balanced — base unit 8px, section padding 24px, component padding 16px, gap 12px Accent: #D4AF37 — from brand context (gold, Bambani Logistics brand color); used only for primary CTAs and key highlights Typography:
  • Headings: Barlow Condensed — h1 40px, h2 28px, h3 20px; weight 700; letter-spacing 0.02em
  • Body: IBM Plex Sans — 16px, line-height 1.5
  • Small / captions: 14px, color textSecondary
Color roles:
  • background — #F8F9FB
  • surface — #FFFFFF
  • text — #002147 (Oxford Blue — brand primary)
  • textSecondary — #5A5F66
  • border — #E6E8EC
  • accent — #D4AF37
  • success — #1F9D55
  • warning — #D4AF37
  • error — #D64545
Radius & shadow: radius 10px (md) for cards and inputs; 6px (sm) for badges and inline elements; shadow 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05) (subtle, borders preferred) Component rules:
  • Button: Primary — bg #D4AF37, text #002147, radius 10px, padding 12px 24px, font-weight 700, uppercase tracking; hover — darken to #B8962E; focus — 2px offset ring in #D4AF37; disabled — opacity 0.45; loading — inline spinner left of label. Secondary — bg #FFFFFF, border 1px solid #E6E8EC, text #002147; hover — bg #F8F9FB. Danger — bg #D64545, text white.
  • Input: bg #FFFFFF, border 1px solid #E6E8EC, radius 10px, padding 10px 14px, body font; focus — border #D4AF37, no shadow; error — border #D64545 + inline error text below in #D64545; disabled — bg #F8F9FB, muted text
  • Card: bg #FFFFFF, border 1px solid #E6E8EC, radius 10px, padding 24px; no shadow by default; use left 3px solid #D4AF37 accent border for highlighted/active cards (waybill, billing summary)
  • Nav: Top bar — bg #002147, text white, height 56px, padding 0 24px; brand name in Barlow Condensed 20px gold; bottom border 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); logout link right-aligned in textSecondary tint
  • Modal: Semi-opaque backdrop rgba(0,0,0,0.45); panel bg #FFFFFF, radius 16px, padding 32px; escape closes; focus trapped inside; no blur effects
State coverage:
  • Interactive: default, hover (darken/bg shift), focus (visible ring #D4AF37), disabled (opacity 0.45, cursor not-allowed), loading (spinner + label)
  • Data views: empty (icon + message + CTA in card wrapper), loading (skeleton rows with pulse animation), error (inline #D64545 message + retry CTA)
Accessibility contract:
  • All text on #002147 backgrounds uses white or #D4AF37 — both exceed 4.5:1 contrast
  • Focus rings are always visible: 2px solid #D4AF37 with 2px offset on dark surfaces, 2px solid #002147 on light surfaces
  • All form inputs have explicit <label> elements; errors use aria-describedby linking to error message
  • Semantic HTML throughout: <nav>, <main>, <section>, <header>, correct heading hierarchy per view
  • Touch targets minimum 44px height on all interactive elements
Signature element: Oxford Blue command bar with gold-ruled waybill stamp — every dispatch screen features a full-bleed #002147 header bar with the Bambani gold wordmark, and the Digital Waybill card uses a physical-document aesthetic: dashed border, a rotated gold-ink stamp overlay reading the company name, and a fine horizontal rule separating metadata rows. This gives the platform the feel of digitised logistics paperwork — instantly recognisable as purpose-built, not a generic SaaS shell. Looking at your existing prototype, I can see a solid foundation with four clear screens: biometric login, main hub, dispatch/waybill, and billing. Here's what the rebuild will deliver: **What's being upgraded:** - The raw inline styles will be replaced with a proper design system using **Oxford Blue + Gold** branding throughout - **Barlow Condensed + IBM Plex Sans** font pairing for a professional logistics/enterprise feel - A persistent **top navigation bar** so users always know where they are - The waybill gets a **physical document aesthetic** — the signature element of this design - Billing view gets a proper **invoice summary card** with line items, not just a single price - All four screens get **proper hover, focus, and loading states** - Mobile-first responsive layout ## The Plan 1. **Update `package.json`** to add no new dependencies — Google Fonts will be loaded via a `` tag in `index.html`, keeping the bundle lean 2. **Update `index.html`** to import `Barlow Condensed` and `IBM Plex Sans` from Google Fonts and set a base CSS reset with the background color token 3. **Create `src/styles.css`** to define all design tokens as CSS custom properties, global resets, and reusable utility classes for buttons, cards, badges, and the nav bar 4. **Rewrite `src/App.jsx`** with all four views rebuilt from scratch using semantic HTML (`

  • Biometric Splash — Oxford Blue full-bleed with radial gold glow, animated loading state with spinner, encrypted session indicator
  • Command Centre (Hub) — Sticky nav bar with dispatch counter, three live stat tiles, four module tiles with loading states, and a Recent Activity list that shows skeleton loaders on mount then real dispatch records with status badges
  • Hot Shot Dispatch — Vehicle/route dropdowns, driver and cargo inputs with inline validation errors, a live-updating Digital Waybill preview card with the signature rotated gold stamp, and a "Stamping Waybill…" loading state on finalize
  • Billing & Payments — Full itemised invoice with VAT breakdown, reference number, status badge lifecycle (awaiting → processing → confirmed/error), error state with retry CTA, confirmed receipt with print action
**All design system states covered:** hover, focus rings, disabled, loading spinners, empty state, skeleton loaders, inline form errors, and success/danger/neutral badges throughout.
